verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de has a documented REST API that creates notarization requests for submitted documents, with AI detection of signature and date fields. It also accepts structured company data for incorporation, and for tax registration it generates an ELSTER XML document and sends it to the tax office. Generating and populating documents from data is evidenced only for the tax-registration XML, so arbitrary legal documents cannot be shown to be built this way, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: general template-based legal document generation and population, an evidenced machine-readable API spec, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can generate, populate, and send legal documents programmatically through a documented API

citations.quote: This endpoint creates a notarization request for a document
Submit a company's details to start its tax registration. An ELSTER XML document will be generated and sent the tax office, which reviews and files the registration.
This endpoint creates an incorporation request for a company in Germany such as a GmbH or UG, including company details, shareholders, and directors.
Signature and location/date fields will be automatically identified across the entire document using AI-powered detection.
